tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gtad rul lag len dang 'don bsgrigs byad ma 'joms pa'i mtshon cha bzhugs so//

༄༅// snying rje'i rang rtsal mchog gi byin mthu yis// 'gro la bde ba'i 'dod dgu sbyin mkhas pa// byams pa'i sems kyi go cha bla na med// drin can bla ma'i zhabs pad spyi bor bsten// rab 'jigs gdul dka' mi bsrun mda' lnga'i dpung*// rab gtum khros pa'i phyag rgya skad cig la// rab rngam zil gyis gnon mdzad dpal ldan che// rab bsngags lha khyod bdud sde'i dpung las rgyal// gang gi rgyud gzhung gdams zab las// gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan bshams kyi// mthu gtad pha rol zlog pa dang*// nus pa gzhom zhing mnan pa'i las// man ngag lag len gab pa'i tshig /rtogs dka' 'don rim nag 'gros su// spel la bla ma yi dam gyi// bka' yis gnang ba bstsal du gsol// byang chub sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rgyud 'dzin gyis// snying gi nor ltar 'di nyid gces// gzhan phan sems kyis go bder bri// 'dir zangs gling gter byon mkhas pa dbang phyug gi gtad rul zhal gdams le tshan ltar la/ yi dam 'jam dpal gshin rje'i yang zlog la brten pa bya rgyu'i lag len bca' gzhi sgrig pa dang*/ cho ga'i sgrub gzhung 'don lugs gsal bar 'god pa la/ thog mar gang du bya ba'i gnas khang byi dor legs par bya zhing yol ba bla bres mdzes par bya/ yi dam gyi sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun du/ stegs bu gru bzhi'i dbus su 'bru dkar gyis chos 'byung zur gsum byas pa'i steng 'bru nag gi chos 'byung rim pa gsum ldan gyi dbus su gtso bo'i tshom bu che ba gcig dang*/ phyogs bzhir gtso bo'i sum cha yod pa re bkod/ de steng mañdzi 'am e bkram lta bu'i steng du/ srung zlog gi lcags slang nang du/ 'bru nag gi ngar phye khrag chang gis sbrus pa gtso bo'i gtor ma zur gsum bra gzugs sman raka rgyun lam lto bar khram ris/ 'khor bzhi po mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon la bzo dbyibs gtso bo dang 'dra ba gtso bo'i sum cha re yod pa bkod/

de'i mdun mtheb skyu bcad kha phyir bstan pa re bzhag /lcags sam bhan+dha ni lcags snod du 'bru nag la gru gsum drang thad rtse mor mda' mdung mtshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan pa bshams/ gtor ma gnyis kyi mthar skyer pa mgo mjug ma log pa/ bzo dbyibs gru gsum rtse mo rno ba'i logs su khrag gis byug cing*/ rtser gri khrag dang dug khrag byugs/ sked par ro sol dang thal chen byugs pa rnams mthar mthong rgyud ltar bkod/ gtor gdugs tsaka li zhal gsum rnams yod na 'dzugs shing med kyang chog /gtor rtser mtshe yungs rtsang srung zlog 'khor lo bcas nges par dgos pas 'dzugs/ mdun ngos su mchod pa chu gnyis nyer spyod sman raka rdzas ldan thun gtor thun bzhi dang*/ nang re dbu 'dzugs skabs 'bul rgyu bcas mtheb skyu lnga tshom lnga bkod gral 'dzin la bka' brgyad cha gsum/ nyin re las gtor la zhal zas lnga/ mtheb skyu gong gsal/ thun gtor gcig /gtor rgyag nyin gser skyems sngon 'gro dkar gtor/ sa rko sar dkar gtor re/ rlon gtad la klu gtor rgyas pa/ skam gtad la gzhi bdag dkar gtor bcas bzo dgos dang*/ gzhan 'bam zan gtor gsos/ sman raka/ dpal 'bar/ me dgra chu gsod kyi yo byad bcas gtor rgyag spyi 'gro'i nyer bsdogs bya/ rgya shog dri ma med pa la/ rgya snag gis pho 'khor mo 'khor grangs lnga gsum gang rung gzhung nas gsungs pa bzhin 'bri dgos pas/ de'ang 'bri skabs nas bzung 'khor lo rwa dang khyi mgo'i nang ma bcug bar nam mkha' ye mi mthong bar bya/ rdzas byug tshul ni klu'i sngags la klu sman byug /pha rol pa'i byad ma rbod gtong dang dmod bcol la dug khrag byug /rang dang sbyin bdag gi 'dod gsol yod rigs la gla rtsi byug /'khor lo dang rus sbal la klu sman dang dri bzang byugs nas ling khrus byed cing 'khor lo rnams lcags slang du bzhag /nas nag la rten 'brel snying po bzlas nas 'khor lo la gtor zhal gdan gyis/

bdag cag ngan sngags phung bshig gi sbyor ba nas/ phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod cing nas nag po 'thor/ pho 'khor phyogs gcig dang mo 'khor phyogs gcig tu bcer te/ lcags snod du kha yar bstan khebs nag po bkab/ gtor chen 'og gam nye logs su bzhag /thun snod gcig tu yungs kar dang ske tshe/ gcig tu yungs nag dang shang tshe/ yang snod gcig tu/ phye gsum/ ngan gsum/ 'bru gsum dug khrag gis sbags pa sogs 'du bya/ gtad rul mnan sa'i sa gnas kyang 'di na byed snyam pa dgos shing dmigs 'og tu bcug /de rnams legs par sgrub pa'i zhag grangs ji tsam bya ba'i thog mar gral 'dzin gyi 'don rim ni/ bdag sdang ma/ ji snyed su dag /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ ma rig rgyu gnyis lan gsum re/ brgyud 'debs/ bka' brgyad cha gsum btang zhing*/ ngag 'don/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar mus 'ded kyis bton pa'i srung sngags/ e ka ya ma mang nyung 'tsham pa bzlas nas/ zhabs brtan bsngo smon gyis grol/ phyi nangs snga phyi ran par langs nas zhog 'tshogs kyi 'don bya ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ brgyud 'debs/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ ma rig rgyu gnyis lan gsum/ ngag 'don/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nas mus 'ded kyis srung sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzlas rjes/ tsaka li zhal phyir bsgyur zhing*/ 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar nag nas/ g.yo 'gul med par gyur bar dang*/ zlog sngags gang 'os bzlas nas/ gtad rul dngos ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// sogs lan gsum bya/ e/ chos kyi dbyings kyi nas/ gur gyi rang bzhin gyur dang*/ a+ye ring nyer gcig tsam 'don cing*/ yang a+ye ring mjug gnod byed a mu ka nas/ mug tig rbad ya btags pa dgu bdun gang rigs 'don/ 'khor lo'i khebs bshus la/ pha rol gyi rigs sngags nas/ nus ldan du gyur bar dang*/ yang zlog gi na mo bla ma'i thal rdeb tshar gsum byas nas/

na mo rje btsun gyi dgug gzhug tshar gsum gyi mjug a+ye ring la/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥnas/ ā we sha ya aḥbar gyi sham bu btags pa 'don/ na mo rnam dag chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing nas/ med par gyis shig bar 'don/ 'khor lor zhal khebs 'gebs/ de nas thun la gtor mar sha zan sman raka sgron/ mchod pa gso/ yang zlog gi dgug gzhug gcig gi mthar/ dam rdzas thun gyi gtor ma 'di la khug /ces brjod nas/ oṃ badz+ra bhañdza ba ling+ta nas/ gtor bsngos 'don cing bstod pa/ e/ thabs mchog bde chen ma'i 'dod gsol 'jug /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /ces zhabs brtan bsngo smon thor bu'i grol bas zhog thun grub/ tsha ting mar/ e/ chos kyi dbyings kyi nas mus 'ded kyis 'don lugs zhog thun ltar byas pa'i bstod pa thabs mchog bde chen ma'i tshab tu bstod ring 'don cing gzhan gong ltar ro/ nyin gung*/ e/ chos kyi dbyings kyi nas 'don lugs sngar ltar gyis a+ye ring bdun tsam 'don rjes 'khor lo pho 'khor gyi sngags bzla dgos pas/ pha rol rbod gtong spu ta nas/ zlog zlog bar brgya stong bzla zhing de mjug /e myag ya rngub mug shag nas/ mā ra ya rbad brgya las mi nyung ba bzla/ yungs kar la sngags te 'khor lo la brab/ gzhan gong ltar la/ bstod pa nyes byas drag bskul 'don pa'o// dgong thun/ e/ chos kyi nas sngar ltar 'don cing*/ a+ye ring grub nas mo 'khor sngags bzla ba ni/ phu phu sid+dhi sid+dhi nas/ thams cad zlog zlog bar brgya stong bzla'o/ e myag ya rngub mug shag nas/ mā ra ya dzaḥbargya las mi nyung ba bzlas pas yungs nag la sngags te 'khor lor brab rjes/ gtad rul shog sgril sngags/ nā ga ti pa tsa nas/ zlog zlog bcas par gang thon re bzla/ na mo rnam dag sogs grub nas/ thun gtor bsham/ na mo bla ma'i thal rdeb gsum gyi mjug dgug gzhug mthar/ badz+ra bhañdza ba ling+ta nas/ bstod pa/

gru gsum mthing nag dang*/ lcags sam bhan+dha gyer/ lha yi lha mchog nas/ bkra shis shog bar brjod/ srung 'khor bsdu rim dang*/ srung sngags gsum bton nas zhabs brtan sogs bsngo smon bgyis te grol ba ni sgrub zhag ji tsam bya ba'i ring nyin re bzhin thun bzhi'i 'don lugs yin no// de ltar zhag grangs thems nas mnan pa dngos kyi bya ba ni/ 'di nyin nya stong ngam klu thebs dang bstun dgos pas sngon tshud lta rtogs byas pa'i tshes grangs khel ba dang*/ rang dang yon bdag gi rang lo dus tshod ma khel ba bya dgos shing*/ sgrub pa po rnams sha chang dri nga ba'i kha zas spang*/ zhogs thun 'don cha nyin re ltar dang*/ nyi shar la nyin gung gi 'don cha rnams 'don/ nyin gung thun snga tsam byas pa'i dgong thun gyi 'don cha/ e/ chos kyi dbyings nas/ dgug gzhug tshar gsum gyis ā we sha ya aḥbar bton nas/ sgrub po rnams kha lag bkrus te gtsang sbra dang ldan pas/ rlon la glang sha ba'i rwa g.yas pa dang*/ skam la khyi mgo gas chag med pa/ khrus bdar legs par byas pa nam mkhas sbyangs/ klu sman byug /pho 'khor mo 'khor lte bar spra tshil gyis kha sbyar/ de'i nang gser sa 'og la ma song ba re blug /sbyin bdag pho yin na g.yas nas lteb/ mo yin na g.yon nas lteb/ 'og yar lteb/ mgo nas mar lteb/ lte ba'i yig 'bru rnams ma chag pa gal che la nar mor bsgril/ yug sa'i dor ras kyang bsgril/ ras skud sngo dmar gyis dkris shing la chas btum/ rang sgrub pa po la mi gnod pa'i phyir rang gi brla g.yon la lan gsum bskor/ sbyin bdag pho yin na brla g.yon dang*/ mo yin na brla g.yas la lan gsum bskor/ rang 'thag mig nas lan gsum/ g.yag shu'i nang nas phyi la lan gsum/ sgo phyi sgo'i 'og nas phyi skor lan gsum de'i ring a+ye ring sham can 'don/ rwa dang khyi mgo'i nang du nas/ 'bras/ gro rnams phran bu blug /de'i steng 'khor lo bzhag

/de'i steng yos khra bo bdun blug /yang yos tshos ma tshos bdun/ yang yos nag po bdun blug /gzhan 'bru sna/ dar sna/ sman sna/ klu sman bcas blug /rin chen brdar rgyu yang brdar bas khengs par bya/ spra tshil lam la chas kha sbyar chu mi 'gro ba'i ca ga byed cing lag tshag dam po byed/ phung res bsgril/ 66ring chas 'chings/ lcags slang sngar mal du bzhag /sgrub pa po rnams gral du 'khod/ sngon mus thun mjug /na mo rnam dag chos nas/ med par gyis shig bar dang*// gtor gsos 'bul zhing 'gugs gzhug /badz+ra bhañdza ba ling+ta bstod pa bcas mus 'ded// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog bar 'don/ skam gtad gnon yul gzhi bdag gnas pa'i sa dang*/ rlon gtad klu gnas pa'i chu mig gam/ mtsho gang rung zhig tu/ gzhi bdag dkar gtor dang sde brgyad gser skyems btang*/ chu mgo dang*/ gzhi bdag gnas pa'i sa dkyil rang min pa'i g.yas g.yon gang 'gab zhig tu/ rang yi dam lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas gtsod ru thogs te/ sa der chos 'byung gru gsum gyi dbyibs/ dong zabs su khru gang mtho gang sor brgyad yod pa brus/ nang du rdo sgrom bsgrigs pa sogs mthong rgyud ltar dang*/ yang zlog gtor rgyag rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig nges par dgos shing*/ de'ang rgyas pa 'di skabs 'grub khag pas bsdus pa dang 'brel ba'i zlog dmigs bsgyur ba ni/ zlog sngags 'don pa sogs sngon nas byas pas 'thus zhing*/ zlog dmigs sgyur skabs rkang gling kyang 'bud nyin gung thun tshar nas/ cher ma 'gyang bar/ dgong thun gi mal du gtor rgyag gser skyems spyi ltar btang*/ skam gtad rlon gtad la dgos pa'i yo byad tshang bar khyer te/ phyir sgor don pa dang*/ rta'i kha snyigs dang skyer pa'i dud pa bdug /rdor slob kyi zhwa'i rtser rma bya'i mdongs ze mo'i byi thur gzer na tshur rang la mi log pa'i gnad yin/ mnan pa'i sa der slebs pa dang*/

klu bsang klu gtor/ sde brgyad gser skyems bcas btang*/ gtad rul lag tu bzung*/ bden stobs brjod pa ni/ rlon la/ hoḥ mtsho 'di nyid la/ skam la/ sa 'di nyid la zhes kha bsgyur byed cing*/ gnas pa'i dam can chos skyong nas// nus pa thams cad rul bar mdzod cig /brjod la gtad rul dong du 'phang*/ lus ngag yid gsum nas/ rul bar mdzod cig /'di tshar gsum 'don/ de rjes/ nam mkha' med pa nas/ ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro bar 'don/ dong kha rgyab bsgyur lag tshag dam zhing ru ngar bya/ srung dmigs brtan po bya zhing phyi mig mi blta bar log /sgrub khang sgo phyir slebs skabs rnam 'joms dang byad 'grol sku gsung thugs kyi sngags tshar kha shas 'don/ khrus bya/ gu gul bdug /nang du 'byor 'phral gtor chen la gtor gsos 'bul/ mdun bskyed ye shes pa sprul pa'i dmag dang bcas pa dgra yul du chas par dmigs te/ gtor 'bul/ a+ye ring 'don cing*/ gtor ma 'phang phyogs su khyer/ sgrub po rnams rol mo yo byad tshang ba dang bcas phyin te/ zlog byang a ti ma gyer zhing*/ 'bam zan brab/ rdor slob kyis dgug gzhug gsum la rak+ta sman raka gtor gsos bcas spyi ltar sgron/ badz+ra bhañdza ba ling+ta nas/ gru gsum mthing nag /lcags sam bhan+dha 'don cing gtor ma thebs phyogs su 'phang*/ gtor mnan me dgra chus gsod bcas dang*/ tho la nang skor dgu phyi skor dgu/ bye ma'i la dgu lung dgu rgyab pa sogs 'don cha lag len yang zlog gtor rgyag spyi ltar byas pas 'thus/ sgrub po rnams sgrub khang du log nas/ gtor gsos sman raka bran/ gtor bsngos tshar gcig bton nas/ bstod pa/ thabs mchog bde chen nas/ dngos grub rnam gnyis 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog bar brjod cing*/ bsdu rim bya/ zhabs brtan bsngo smon bka' brgyud bla ma bcas kyis grol ba yin no// de ltar zil gnon lha yi las sgrub pa'i// las bzhi'i phrin las rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs las// yang bcud ches zab kum+bhar gtams pa gang*// rmongs blo'i rab rib dri ma bsal bya'i phyir// phyag len don gsal g.ya' bral me long gang*// dpyod ldan mdzes pa'i rgyan du bris pa nyid// dge bas chos byed rnams la nyer 'tshe ba'i// byad ma 'joms pa'i mtshon cha ngar ldan shog

/ces zangs gling gtad rul zhal gdams la/ yang zlog nas srung zlog kyi kha 'gengs dgos rigs 'brel chags byas pa'i 'don rim lag len gyi zin bris nag 'gros byas shing*/ dmigs khrid sgom don bshad sbyar sogs bkod kyang*/ blo gros kyi lang tsho dman pa rnams mgo nyog yong ba'i rgyu bcas bzhag ste/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge sbyong dharma ma ṇi'am/ thugs kyi rdo rjer 'bod pas dbyar rnga'i sgra ldan gyi lor sbyar ba bstan dgra mtha' dag tshar gcod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
